Israeli Film Industry — Conflicts Report
=========================================

HTML reports (open in any browser):
  connections_report.html  — full conflicts report (people, orgs, findings)
  films.html               — films catalog browser

Data files (raw JSON, for programmatic use):
  entity_registry.json     — canonical registry of people and organizations
  movies_db.json           — films database with crew, funding, sources
  derived_conflicts.json   — computed conflict findings

Produced by P-Valyou.
